what: Swaps among several reviews stacked in one spot. The current review’s stars shrink to 0 over .5s power4.inOut (.05 stagger) and its text lines slide up −110% inside line masks (.6s, all staggered within .25s). The next review’s stars grow overlapping by .3s while its new text lines rise from 110% below over .7s (staggered within .4s) with power4.inOut. It advances automatically every 5 seconds (only while visible), and also with the prev·next buttons and the ←·→ keys.

options.every: Auto-advance interval (seconds), default 5 — 0 turns auto-advance off
options.in: Duration of the line coming up (s), default .7
options.[data-fx-part=item]: One review (or several) — stacked in the same cell
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text to swap in by line (several per review possible)
options.[data-fx-part=star]: (if present) star that shrinks then grows
